background.$description: Matches $mild-background in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade: core hardcodes this hex rather than referencing color.gray.950 (#030712).

foreground.$description: Matches $mild-foreground in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.

muted.$description: Matches $mild-muted in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.

muted-foreground.$description: Matches $mild-muted-foreground in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss: 7.85:1 on background, 6.00:1 on muted. Not a palette shade; see background above.

border.$description: core hardcodes #262626 here (same as muted), which is 1.31:1 on background and fails the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum (WCAG 1.4.11). color.gray.500 is 4.10:1; see scripts/check-contrast.ts.

input.$description: Same value as border, and the same fix; core hardcodes #262626 here too.

ring.$description: Matches $mild-ring in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss: 9.24:1 on background, already well above the 3:1 non-text minimum.

card.$description: Matches $mild-card in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.

card-foreground.$description: Matches $mild-card-foreground in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.

popover.$description: Matches $mild-popover in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.

popover-foreground.$description: Matches $mild-popover-foreground in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.

accent.$description: Matches $mild-accent in packages/core/src/sass/themes/dark.scss. Not a palette shade; see background above.
